title: a connect begun while a disconnect is still closing: refused by S3's closing state
evidence: Closed by construction (S3 PR 1, US-25 AC11m): CloudConnection.closing keeps the cloud named, so Sync draws no Connect rows, and its signInStarted and signInReturned cells drop a connect silently; the status reads Disconnecting. CloudConnectionTests testEveryCellOfTheTable_US25_AC11m (closing rows); CloudConnectionPinsTests testAnEditDuringDisconnectsCloseIsRefusedAndLandsNowhere (its Q1 assertions)
